title: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science and Technology has successfully concluded Special Campaign 6 conducted from October 2 - 31, 2026
body_text: Department of Biotechnology has successfully concluded the Special Campaign 6 during 2 nd – 31 st Oct, 2026. 2. The Department has registered significant achievements in Cleanliness, Grievance Redressal, Record Management, and Scrap Disposal, as under :- S. No. Category Targets Achievements Achievement % (i) Cleanliness Campaign Sites 158 191 Sites have been cleaned and beautified across DBT and its Institutes. 121% (ii) No. of items disposed E-waste –2942 Other than e-waste –761 3373 items from e-waste and 737 items from other than e-waste have been disposed. 104% (e-waste) 113% (other than e-waste) (iii) Revenue earned by scrap disposal E-waste - 34,80,515 Other than e-waste -23,61,147 Revenue of ₹ 50,79,846 (through e-waste) and ₹ 25,78,735 (other than e-waste) has been generated through the disposal of scrap and unserviceable items respectively. 145% (e-waste) 109% (other than e-waste) (iv) Space Freed (in Square Feet) 47486 Sq. Ft. 71363 square feet of office space has been freed through systematic cleaning and record management initiatives 150% (v) Record Management (Files) Physical Files –– review - 7773 weed out - 4265 E-Files – review - 18741 11598 physical files and 17013 e- files reviewed out of which 8666 physical files weeded out and 5835 e-files closed. 149% (PF reviewed) 203% (PF weed out) (vi) Public Grievances and Appeals 50 – Grievances + 5 - Appeals 58 pending PGs and 5 Appeal Stands disposed off. 116% (Grievances) 100% (Appeal) 3. For the wide dissemination of this Special Campaign the Department has posted 211 posts and 44 no. of posts with reels/shorts on different social media platforms i.e. X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, Youtube and others. 4. Major Campaign activities and glimpses of some of the best practices undertaken during the Campaign are as under :- A. DBT Secretariat: A storage room was renovated and converted into small committee room. B. At DBT’s AIs: Best Practice of Special Campaign 6, Department of Biotechnology S.No Name of the Institute Picture of the Best Practice Before & After Month, Year of Implementation 1 Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) October 2026 2 National Institute of Immunology October 2026 3. Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development October 2026 4. Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) October 2026 5. The successful conclusion of Special Campaign 6 reflects the Department's continued commitment to institutionalizing Swachhata, ensuring the timely disposal of pending matters, strengthening record management, optimizing the utilization of space and promoting employee welfare. The signiﬁcant achievements demonstrate the collective efforts and active participation of all Divisions (including Autonomous Institutes and Public Sector Undertaking) and employees of the Department in making the campaign a success. ****** NKR/AK
